Tapu Fini

Water Fairy

Alola · Generation 7 · Legendary Pokémon

Tapu Fini is a Water/Fairy-type Land Spirit Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 1.3 m tall and weighs 21.2 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Def (130), with a base stat total of 570.
